cases.notes: Alias names match AST names; Type/property names have separate hyphen-friendly spelling.

cases.source: beads as b where b is encoding-note
cases.notes: Resolve Type name to absolute nominal URI; do not parse as subtraction.

cases.source: outgoing("A", depth: 2) as l through any outgoing(l.target) as x through x is references where l.status = "draft"
cases.notes: Parenthesize a quantifier in through to make its clause boundary explicit.

cases.source: outgoing("A", depth: 2) as l through (any outgoing(l.target) as x through x is references) where l.status = "draft"
cases.notes: Outer filter wraps walk; draft condition does not prune traversal.

cases.source: outgoing("A", depth: 2) as l through (any outgoing(l.target) as x through x is references where l.status = "draft")
cases.notes: Draft condition belongs inside any predicate, so can prune outer walk.

cases.source: beads as b where b.status = "draft" and any outgoing(b)
cases.notes: A quantified predicate used as a Boolean operand must be parenthesized.

cases.source: beads as b where b.status = "draft" and (any outgoing(b))
cases.notes: Explicit Boolean boundary; no implicit alias.
